SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

File No.......
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. T. O. D.../E.9.... Station,
Date...April...17...1929.

Subject (in full) Arrival of Soviet agent

Made by J. G. Ovsiannikoff Forwarded by H. Givens A. B. Pol.

The undermentioned Soviet Agent arrived in Shanghai
from Harbin via Dairen on the s.s. "Kotou Maru" on April 1, 1929.
Comrade Kovenko Soviet Agent, Representative of Soviet
mercantile fleet. Resided until April 3
in the Palace Hotel but later removed
to an unknown address. Endeavours
are being made to locate him.

It is reported that he arrived here in connection
with proposed purchase by the Soviet mercantile fleet of the
s.s. "Isabelle" now somewhere in Foochow undergoing repairs.

V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.

AR 14/37
Key.
A/ D.C.I.

Copy to: H. B. M. Consul General
Col. Nalland,
Capt. Shelley
Lieut. Carlson
6. Y In 17.4

报告

档案编号.......
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
T. O. D.../E.9.... 分局，
日期...1929年4月17日。

事由（详述）苏联代理人抵沪

制作人 J. G. Ovsiannikoff 转呈人 H. Givens A. B. Pol.

下述苏联代理人于1929年4月1日乘坐“Kotou Maru”号轮船，经大连从哈尔滨抵达上海。
科文科同志（Comrade Kovenko），苏联代理人，苏联商船队代表。其居住于华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）直至4月3日，随后搬至一处不明地址。目前正在设法查明其下落。

据报，他此次来沪与苏联商船队拟购买“Isabelle”号轮船一事有关，该船目前正于福州某处进行修理。

V. Ovsiannikoff
副警司（D. S.）

AR 14/37
索引。
A/ 助理刑事侦缉处长（D.C.I.）

抄送：英国驻沪总领事
纳兰德上校（Col. Nalland），
谢利上尉（Capt. Shelley）
卡尔森中尉（Lieut. Carlson）
